title: Full Stack Developer - S
description:
Key Responsibilities Develop and maintain responsive web applications using React.js . Design, build, and maintain backend APIs and services using Python . Develop and optimize database schemas, queries, and stored procedures in PostgreSQL . Deploy, monitor, and maintain applications in Microsoft Azure environments. Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Product Managers, UI/UX Designers, QA Engineers, and DevOps teams. Implement secure, reusable, and scalable application architectures. Integrate third-party APIs and services as required. Perform code reviews and ensure adherence to coding standards and best practices. Utilize Git for source code management, branching, merging, and version control. Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve application issues across the technology stack. Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives. Write technical documentation and support knowledge-sharing initiatives. 
 Required Skills & Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. 3+ years of experience in full-stack application development. Strong hands-on experience with React.js , JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, and RESTful APIs. Proficiency in Python and backend frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, or Django . Experience with PostgreSQL database design, query optimization, and performance tuning. Good understanding of Microsoft Azure services such as App Services, Azure Functions, Azure Storage, Azure SQL, Azure DevOps, and Azure Monitor. Experience with Git , GitHub, GitLab, or Azure Repos. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices. Knowledge of authentication and authorization mechanisms such as OAuth2, JWT, and SSO. Understanding of microservices architecture and cloud-native development principles. Strong problem-solving, debugging, and analytical skills.
